Displaying or Editing Other Business Partners
Displaying or Editing Other Business Partners
Prerequisites
Several business partners must be assigned to the contract account.
Procedure
You can use the
Other
Partner
function to switch between the data of individual partners in the contract account.
On the SAP Easy Access screen, choose
Master Data
Contract Account
Display
(
CAA3
).
Enter the required contract account.
Then choose
Goto
Other
Partner
.
The system displays a selection window for the business partners already assigned to the contract account.
Choose a business partner.
The data for this business partner is displayed and can be processed.
